flashcard_questions.q: The regulation of internal conditions of a cell or organism to maintain optimum conditions for function, in response to internal and external changes.
A change in the environment (internal or external) that is detected by a receptor.
Muscles or glands that carry out a response to a stimulus, restoring optimum conditions.

flashcard_questions.a: The organ system that enables humans to react to their surroundings and coordinate their behaviour, consisting of the brain, spinal cord, and nerves.
Nerve cells that carry electrical impulses around the body. Types include sensory, relay, and motor neurones.
